# InfoSecurity Global Q4 2024 Earnings Report

## Executive Summary

InfoSecurity Global delivered exceptional financial performance in fiscal year 2024, reporting record revenue of $8.03 million, representing a robust 22.9% year-over-year growth from the prior year's $6.53 million. The company achieved net income of $761,679 with a healthy operating margin of 9.5%, demonstrating strong operational efficiency and disciplined cost management. With a workforce of 2,747 employees, InfoSecurity Global continues to scale its operations effectively while maintaining profitability in the competitive manufacturing technology sector.

## Revenue and Profitability Analysis

The company's impressive 22.9% revenue growth significantly outpaced industry averages, driven by increased demand for integrated manufacturing solutions and successful market penetration strategies. Revenue per employee reached approximately $2,923, reflecting improved productivity and operational leverage. The 9.5% operating margin demonstrates InfoSecurity Global's ability to convert top-line growth into sustainable profitability while investing in research and development, sales infrastructure, and talent acquisition. The strong margin performance indicates effective pricing strategies and operational efficiency gains across the organization's manufacturing-focused technology solutions.

## Business Segment Performance

InfoSecurity Global's three core product lines—Quality Control, Production Planning, and Maintenance solutions—collectively contributed to the strong financial results, with particular strength in manufacturing sector implementations. The company's integrated approach to manufacturing technology has resonated well with enterprise clients seeking comprehensive operational efficiency improvements. Market demand for digital transformation in manufacturing processes, predictive maintenance capabilities, and real-time quality monitoring systems drove significant customer acquisition and contract renewals throughout the fiscal year.

## Forward-Looking Guidance

Looking ahead to fiscal year 2025, InfoSecurity Global is well-positioned to maintain strong growth momentum, targeting revenue growth in the high-teens percentage range as the company expands its manufacturing client base and enhances its product portfolio. Management anticipates continued investment in artificial intelligence and IoT capabilities to strengthen competitive positioning in quality control and predictive maintenance markets. The company expects to maintain operating margins in the 9-11% range while scaling operations and pursuing strategic growth initiatives in the expanding manufacturing technology sector.
